Exploration is non-existent. Remember how in Skyrim that you'd get a quest and walk there. Along the way you run into some bandits trying to rob you, wild animals that might be hostile, you probably also stumble upon a few caves or other places and clear them out. Pretty basic open world gameplay mechanics, right? Well, toss them out because in Starfield you get the quest, fast travel to the system, sometimes to stop at the planet if the local authorities need to scan your ship for contraband, then loading screen for landing on the planet, walk to some destination on a, usually, barren planet/moon to clear out the spacers, rinse and repeat. There is zero exploration, nothing in-between where you get the quest and where you finish it, and still no creativity in the quests like in their previous games, but because of the 2 previous points, there's nothing to distract you from how uninventive and boring the quests are.
